notes: Fix: colour swatches/picker in the Timeline inspector didn't visibly change text in Glow style. The colour control always wrote the text colour (textco), but Glow shows the glow-text colour (glowtextco) — so picks were invisible. The inspector colour control (presets + custom picker) now writes the field that's actually visible for the active style: Glow → glowtextco, every other style → textco. The initial swatch highlight reads the same style-appropriate field, and switching style rebuilds the swatches so the highlight follows. Verified: Glow + red/purple updates the visible text; Plain + green updates it too.
